fix_summary.defect: The APPLY read-back (and the idempotency compliance check) compared the task Principal.UserId to the bare string 'guvfx_u_46'. schtasks STORES a task principal as a SID, so a read-back returns e.g. S-1-5-21-2216203845-1747098376-1637942580-1065. The string compare then reported readback_mismatch for a CORRECT task; the installer fail-closed-deleted it, and the rollout-retry (packet 105) rolled the host back to DARK. Root cause: principal representation mismatch after a successful native task registration - the GFX-COPIER-PARITY-VALIDATOR-FIX-013 Defect-2 (principal resolution) resurfacing in the installer read-back.
fix_summary.fix: A top-level Resolve-GuvfxPrincipalSid canonicalizes a principal reference (SID string / bare local name / HOST\name) to its SID via authoritative Windows identity translation (System.Security.Principal.NTAccount / SecurityIdentifier .Translate), returning $null on ANY lookup/translation failure (FAIL CLOSED) - never a lowercase/substring/suffix match; a SID string must round-trip to a real account (a dangling SID fails). A nested Test-PrincipalCanonical resolves BOTH the pinned $PRINCIPAL ('guvfx_u_46', derived from $PINNED=46) and the returned principal to SIDs and compares SID-to-SID; both read-back sites use it. The resolver is injectable ($ResolvePrincipalSid) for deterministic tests. Behaviour-preserving: exact task name, account-46 pin, DISABLED, zero triggers, fixed action/arguments, no-secret, and fail-closed deletion on a genuine mismatch are all unchanged; the render-validation still string-checks the RENDERED UserId == the bare 'guvfx_u_46' (it validates what the installer wrote). #48/Customer Zero/reserved/arbitrary principals are never reachable (a different account's SID never equals the pinned SID).
